evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Complete radial tear of the posterior root of medial meniscus with mild extrusion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Partial inner margin radial tear at the anterior horn/body junction of the lateral meniscus without extrusion.
evidence.Medial OA: High-grade cartilage fissuring along the posterior weightbearing medial femoral condyle. Mild marginal spurring at the medial joint line.
evidence.Lateral OA: Low-grade cartilage fissuring spanning the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle. High-grade cartilage fissuring along the posterior lateral tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: Low-grade cartilage fissuring along the central trochlea. Mild cartilage thinning along the medial patellar facet with mild subchondral cystic change.
evidence.Contusion: Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process.
evidence.Fracture: Subchondral insufficiency fracture at the medial margin of the medial tibial plateau without articular surface collapse.
